articles.title: Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales sign historic MoU to break away from UK
articles.summary: Leaders from Scotland, Northern Ireland, and Wales signed a pact seeking independence. This historic agreement signals a shift away from Westminster's long-standing control.

articles.summary: A woman's family will file a police complaint after her two-wheeler was hit by a car. The family alleges four drunk individuals were inside the vehicle which caused her distress.

articles.title: In 1998, 31 Przewalski’s horses entered Chernobyl and reached 137 by 2018
articles.summary: After the Chernobyl disaster, an abandoned radioactive landscape became an unlikely refuge for Przewalski’s horses, a species once lost from the wild. Introduced in 1998–99, the population suffered transport deaths and poaching but continued breeding.

articles.title: Indian-origin UK nurse wins $250,000 Global Nursing Award for boosting organ donation among South Asians
articles.summary: In a remarkable achievement, Indian-origin nurse Agimol Pradeep has clinched the Aster Guardians Global Nursing Award 2026, celebrated for her impactful advocacy in organ and stem-cell donation. The $250,000 award will see half allocated to Upahaar's efforts in expanding organ donation initiatives.

articles.title: ‘Jana Nayagan’ actor, TN CM Vijay deepfake case: Man arrested in Rajasthan
articles.summary: In Rajasthan, a man named Shayabu Khan has been apprehended for producing deepfake videos featuring actor Vijay, which were utilized to execute financial fraud schemes against the public. On September 12, police seized mobile phones and SIM cards linked to the crime in Alwar district.

articles.title: Delhi HC dismisses plea against notices to actors promoting pan masala
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court dismissed a plea by PB Agro challenging Maharashtra FDA notices. These notices were issued to actors regarding alleged surrogate promotion of a pan masala brand.
